item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Shield T-Shirt
item_short_desc: Show your respect and support for law enforcement with Rothco's Thin Blue Line Shield T-Shirt. This athletic cut t-shirt is designed with an updated fit, featuring an insert collar, wider chest, armholes, and sleeve openings for enhanced comfort and mobility. Crafted from a soft yet durable blend of 60% cotton and 40% polyester, this shirt offers the perfect balance of comfort and durability. The t-shirt proudly displays the Thin Blue Line Shield on both the front and back, a symbol of solidarity with police and law enforcement officials.
